test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The given pie-charts show the distribution of Graduate and Post-Graduate level students in five different colleges A, B, C, D and E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/726295261755ed193789407ce044f70fd53223e26b1e34c819f177ac273f3b30.png] 

How many students of colleges A and B are studying at Graduate level?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of students in College A = (18 / 100) × 18,900 = 3,402

Number of students in College B = (19 / 100) × 18,900 = 3,591

Total number of students in Colleges A and B = 3,402 + 3,591 = 6,993

**∴ The total number of students studying at the Graduate level in Colleges A and B is 6,993.**
